protocol.rules: Frozen shared mandatory-action/mandatory-refresh engine and legality adapter for ALL historical and candidate policies; historical source unchanged; audit privacy view enabled, public observations enabled.

primary.resampling: whole seed clusters, equal cluster weight
primary.rng: LCG initial 918273, a1664525,c1013904223,uint32; reset for each endpoint
primary.limitation: Cluster bootstrap approximate inference with 30 independent clusters; not exact finite-sample coverage

protocol.secondary: All five comparisons overall/by lineup/start/color, descriptive two-sided 95% cluster bootstrap indices2499/97499; do not select ablation or claim superiority from this gate
protocol.truncation: Retain all; half point primary, candidate truncated=0 sensitivity (selfbaseline remains half); each comparison <=1% truncated; engine never declares draw at cutoff
protocol.correctnessGate: zero rule violations/engine errors, full tests/privacy/natural-case checks pass
protocol.performanceGate: Six heroes x 3-hand/6-hand/long-public-history >=100 events x10 fixed observations x5 repetitions; per cell candidate/capability baseline median <=2 and p95 <=3; fixed seeds995001..995010; raw timing retained and no concurrent evaluations during measured timing
protocol.stopping: Run all 7200 once before inspecting outcomes. No added seeds after failure. Infrastructure restart resumes exact missing configurations, keeps error log; no dropping outcomes. Strategy never changes. Performance-only behavior-preserving optimization requires recorded equivalence verification and cannot erase original failure. Parent acceptance before default replacement.
